inputs.text: contemporary fine art oil painting, dark moody background, chiaroscuro, a single soft warm light from the upper left, muted desaturated palette, visible painterly brushstrokes, one continuous scene in a wide panorama: in the left half a large serene face of a young woman with closed eyes fills the whole height, auburn hair dissolving into darkness; in the right half the head of a modern sleek dragon made of dark smoke and polished black scales roars with open jaws; the dragon's long body coils from its head down, flows along the bottom and rises up around the woman, wrapping her, elegant modern design, no classic horns
